title: Unified build decomposition: Extract BuildActionPipeline
description:
## Problem
`HtnTaskLibrary.DecomposeBuild` has a ~300-line `if/else` branch separating creative and survival build paths. Most orchestration logic (origin, placement loop, checkpoint, vegetation clearing) is shared between them. The split duplicates code and makes both paths harder to maintain.

## Solution
Extract `BuildActionPipeline` — an injectable pipeline with:
- `IBuildMaterialProvider` — interface for material acquisition (creative vs survival)
- Shared placement loop, checkpoint, origin, vegetation clearing
- CreativeMaterialProvider and SurvivalMaterialProvider implementations

Reference: `Data/Pages/Audit/survival-creative-build-decomposition-analysis.md`

## Files
- Agent.Construction/BuildActionPipeline.cs (new)
- Agent.Construction/Interfaces/IBuildMaterialProvider.cs (new)
- Agent.Construction/CreativeMaterialProvider.cs (new)
- Agent.Construction/SurvivalMaterialProvider.cs (new)
- Agent.Planning/HtnTaskLibrary.cs (refactor DecomposeBuild)

## Validation
- Both creative and survival build paths produce identical action sequences
- All existing build tests pass
- No regressions in blueprint placement
